changelog:
Aligned shared dialogs with native CloudStream typography, spacing and bounded title/body scrolling.
Fixed open-dialog font-scale updates and kept long native titles readable at their intended size.
Preserved keyboard resize/pan behavior and refused obsolete preference writes after screen, row or store replacement.
Fixed Android TV decision focus, navigation rebuilds and readable list space in short or keyboard-constrained windows.
Improved supported feature discovery and search routing while retaining unsupported and default-OFF feature gates.
Preserved native navigation items, saved choices and exact Home/player/Discord/cache lifecycle ownership.
Verified automated off-device contracts and packaging; physical CloudStream, TV, playback and account behavior remain separate checks.
message: Native dialog fit, keyboard handling and owner-safe navigation fixes
